description: Native downloads of online media links, from the host window only: any web address on any port except localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1] and 0.0.0.0. The deny list compares addresses as written (other loopback, network or link-local addresses, and names that resolve to this computer, aren't caught). Redirects are checked too (plugins.http.scopeRedirects in tauri.conf.json).
